purpose: Integrate Multi-View preprocessing and reverse expansion for 4 non-phonetic maritime exception categories (Letter-by-Letter, Company Initials, Maritime Semantics, Numeral Canonicalization) into DPR-Hybrid pipeline and benchmark performance against DPR-HYBRID-01 (AS-07).
hypothesis: Maritime vessel names with non-phonetic representations (e.g. SK <-> 에스케이, HD <-> 현대, SUN <-> 태양, NO.2 <-> 2호) cannot be bridged by pure G2P phonetic models alone. Injecting deterministic Multi-View tokenization and reverse expansions will elevate target exception retrieval into Top-1~5 without corrupting base sound embeddings or breaking clean predictions.
changed_factors: Added 4 non-phonetic exception extractors in phonetic_encoder/tokenizer.py (canonicalize_numerals, extract_acronym_view, extract_initial_view, extract_semantic_view)
Added reverse Latin multi-view expanders in phonetic_encoder/tokenizer.py (expand_latin_acronym, expand_latin_initials, expand_latin_semantics)
Updated phonetic_encoder/model.py to fuse native + Romanized + auxiliary views ([ACR], [INIT], [SEM]) with calibrated weight 0.8
Exported multi-view catalog embeddings (78,595 x 128 FP16, 19.19 MiB) to artifacts/DPR-SYMPHON-01/catalog_embeds_multiview_fp16.npy
Benchmarked on Heldout Fold 0 (2,372 rows) under clean and noise stress conditions (default and severe presets, seed 20261022)
fixed_conditions: eval_kit/folds_group5_seed42.csv Group 5-Fold split (Fold 0 held out strictly, zero leakage)
Dense weight in hybrid matcher: dense_weight=2.5
No train lookup used (use_train_lookup=False, zero memorization)
